mapper.select: SELECT r.role_name FROM app_user u, ROLE r, t_user_role ur WHERE u.user_id = #{loginId} AND ur.user_id = u.user_id AND r.role_id = ur.role_id
SELECT P.url FROM permission P, t_role_permission rp, t_user_role ur WHERE ur.user_id = #{loginId} AND rp.role_id = ur.role_id AND P.permission_id = rp.permission_id
